why: Drops the check that the DevTools safe-area override reached the page, for the top and side insets alike. Headless Chromium reports every env(safe-area-inset-*) as 0, and the no-inset half of issue #687's matrix passed on the unfixed tree at every viewport -- so an override that silently stopped applying would turn the discriminating half into a second copy of the half that proves nothing, and the gate would stay green.
killedBy: topbar clearance verdict (issue #687) fails an inset the page never applied, rather than passing a 0px inset as a real one
